description: This Java class implements the <set-calendar> element for the OFBiz MiniLang framework, allowing calendar date manipulation within the mini-language. It handles parsing attributes, executing scriptlets, and adjusting calendar timestamps based on specified parameters.

classes.name: SetCalendar
classes.description: Implements the <set-calendar> element, providing functionality to set and manipulate calendar objects based on input attributes and scripts within the OFBiz MiniLang framework.

classes.name: SetCalendarFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of SetCalendar from XML elements.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Parses integer strings, handling '+' characters to avoid exceptions in certain Java versions.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the <set-calendar> operation, adjusting calendar timestamps based on attributes, scripts, and period alignment settings.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <set-calendar> element with its attributes.
